fact: As of its 18 June 2020 notice, the governments of Liberia, Cote d'Ivoire, Sierra Leone and Guinea owned TRANSCO CLSG, on whose interconnection line OPGW fibre was being installed, with 40 of 48 fibres to be marketed as excess capacity.
title: Request for Expression of Interest: Technical assistance to the marketing of TRANSCO CLSG OPGW excess capacity
